settings.heading: Help
settings.text: Delivery, returns, ingredients and accounts. If the answer is not here, our formulation team replies within one working day.

settings.question: Do I need an account to order?
settings.answer: No. Checkout works with a phone number and a delivery address. An account is created automatically after your first order so the next one is one tap, and you can sign in any time with a six-digit SMS code or with Google.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel after ordering?
settings.answer: Until the parcel is picked, yes. Message us with the order number and we will edit or cancel it. Once it is with the carrier you can refuse delivery or use the 60-day return.

settings.question: Do you sell gift cards?
settings.answer: Not yet. The most-gifted option is the duo pack, which arrives in a plain box with no prices on the paperwork.

settings.title: Where we ship and how long it takes.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders leave Sintra within 24 working hours. Portugal and Spain take two to three days, the rest of the EU three to five, the UK four to six. You get a tracking link by SMS when the label is printed.

settings.question: When is delivery free?
settings.answer: Free over $75 after any discount. Below that it is a flat $4.90, or you can collect from our Lisbon studio at no cost.

settings.question: Do you ship outside Europe?
settings.answer: Not at the moment. We list every market we can ship to at checkout; if your country is missing, leave your email on the product page and we will write when it opens.

settings.question: What is the return window?
settings.answer: Sixty days from delivery, including opened bottles. Skin takes six to eight weeks to answer a new formula, so a half-used bottle is a fair test, not an abuse of the policy.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Open Orders in your account and choose the order, or message us with the order number. We send a prepaid label; refunds land within five working days of the parcel reaching us.

settings.question: What if something arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Send one photo of the bottle and the box. We ship a replacement the same day and you keep the damaged unit — no return needed.

settings.question: Are the formulas fragrance-free?
settings.answer: Nine of the twelve carry no fragrance at all. The three that do are marked on the product page and in the filters, and use a fixed essential-oil blend rather than a masking fragrance.

settings.question: Which product comes first in a routine?
settings.answer: Cleanser, then any water-light serum, then moisturiser, then SPF in the morning. The product page for each formula names what it layers with and what it should not meet on the same night.

settings.question: Are they tested on animals?
settings.answer: No, at any stage and in any market — including the ones that would require it, which is why we do not sell there. Leaping Bunny certified since 2021.

settings.question: How long does a bottle last?
settings.answer: About eight weeks at the dose on the label, or four months for a duo pack. Unopened shelf life is thirty months; once opened, use within twelve.

settings.title: Sign in, saved items and subscriptions.

settings.question: How do I sign in?
settings.answer: Tap the account icon. Enter your phone number and we send a six-digit code — no password. You can also continue with Google if you prefer.

settings.question: Where do saved items live?
settings.answer: In Saved, inside your account. Items you heart are kept on the device you saved them on, and move with you once you sign in.

settings.question: Can I pause a subscription?
settings.answer: Skip, delay or cancel from the Subscription tab with no notice period. Changes made before the cut-off date apply to the next shipment.

settings.heading: A formulator answers, not a script.
settings.text: Mon–Fri, 9–18 WET. Average reply about six hours. Order questions are fastest with your order number to hand.
